name: FRED — Activation
description: First open through funded. Mixes CLIENT events (the app opening, onboarding steps) with SERVER events (the money), which is the only way to see the whole path.

tiles.name: First open to funded
tiles.description: The full path. The first three steps come from the device and the last two from the server, so a drop between step 3 and 4 can also mean a user who never came back rather than one who failed.

tiles.name: Time to funded
tiles.description: Distribution of how long the full funnel takes to complete, from first open to the first settled transfer. The MySQL view v_time_to_funded is the authority on the median; this is for shape.

tiles.name: Where onboarding stops
tiles.description: Steps viewed but not completed. Read with the funnel above: a step with many views and few completions is a screen problem.

tiles.name: Errors shown, by category
tiles.description: Never the message, only the category. A spike here beside a funnel drop usually explains it.
